mn50:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakalāvane migadāye.
mn50:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahāmoggallāno abbhokāse caṅkamati.
mn50:2.2: tena kho pana samayena māro pāpimā āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa kucchigato hoti koṭṭhamanupaviṭṭho.
mn50:2.6: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno caṅkamā orohitvā vihāraṃ pavisitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn50:3.1: nisajja kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno paccattaṃ yoniso manasākāsi.
mn50:3.2: addasā kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno māraṃ pāpimantaṃ kucchigataṃ koṭṭhamanupaviṭṭhaṃ.
mn50:3.7: mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn50:4.2: “ajānameva kho maṃ ayaṃ samaṇo apassaṃ evamāha:
mn50:4.6: mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā’ti.
mn50:4.7: yopissa so satthā, sopi maṃ neva khippaṃ jāneyya, kuto pana maṃ ayaṃ sāvako jānissatī”ti.
mn50:5.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etadavoca:
mn50:5.2: “etasmiṃ kho tāhaṃ pāpima jānāmi mā tvaṃ maññittho:
mn50:5.6: ‘ajānameva kho maṃ ayaṃ samaṇo apassaṃ evamāha:
mn50:5.10: mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā’ti.
mn50:5.11: yopissa so satthā sopi maṃ neva khippaṃ jāneyya, kuto pana maṃ ayaṃ sāvako jānissatī”ti.
mn50:6.2: jānameva kho maṃ ayaṃ samaṇo passaṃ evamāha:
mn50:6.6: mā te ahosi dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn50:6.7: atha kho māro pāpimā āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa mukhato uggantvā paccaggaḷe aṭṭhāsi.
mn50:7.1: addasā kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno māraṃ pāpimantaṃ paccaggaḷe ṭhitaṃ.
mn50:7.3: etthapi kho tāhaṃ pāpima passāmi. mā tvaṃ maññittho:
mn50:8.1: bhūtapubbāhaṃ pāpima dūsī nāma māro ahosiṃ. tassa me kāḷī nāma bhaginī.
mn50:9.1: tena kho pana pāpima samayena kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
mn50:9.2: kakusandhassa kho pana pāpima bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vidhura - sañjīva nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
mn50:9.3: yāvatā kho pana pāpima kakusandhassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sāvakā,
mn50:9.4: nāssudha koci āyasmatā vidhurena samasamo hoti yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya.
mn50:9.5: iminā kho etaṃ pāpima pariyāyena āyasmato vidhurassa vidhuro vidhurotveva samaññā udapādi.
mn50:10.1: āyasmā pana pāpima sañjīvo araññagatopi rukkhamūlagatopi suññāgāragatopi appakasireneva saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjati.
mn50:10.2: bhūtapubbaṃ pāpima āyasmā sañjīvo aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno nisinno hoti.
mn50:10.3: addasaṃsu kho pāpima gopālakā pasupālakā kassakā pathāvino āyasmantaṃ sañjīvaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjitvā nisinnaṃ.
mn50:10.5: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
mn50:10.8: atha kho te pāpima gopālakā pasupālakā kassakā pathāvino tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca gomayañca saṅkaḍḍhitvā āyasmato sañjīvassa kāye upacinitvā aggiṃ datvā pakkamiṃsu.
mn50:11.1: atha kho pāpima āyasmā sañjīvo tassā rattiyā accayena tāya samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā cīvarāni papphoṭetvā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn50:11.2: addasaṃsu kho te pāpima gopālakā pasupālakā kassakā pathāvino āyasmantaṃ sañjīvaṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ.
mn50:11.4: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
mn50:11.5: ayaṃ samaṇo nisinnakova kālakato svāyaṃ patisañjīvitoti.
mn50:11.6: iminā kho etaṃ pāpima pariyāyena āyasmato sañjīvassa sañjīvo sañjīvotveva samaññā udapādi.
mn50:12.1: atha kho pāpima dūsissa mārassa etadahosi:
mn50:12.2: imesaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sīlavantānaṃ kalyāṇadhammānaṃ neva jānāmi āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā.
mn50:12.4: etha tumhe bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme akkosatha paribhāsatha rosetha vihesetha.
mn50:12.5: appevanāma tumhehi akkosiyamānānaṃ paribhāsiyamānānaṃ rosiyamānānaṃ vihesiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ, yathā taṃ dūsī māro labhetha otāranti.
mn50:12.6: atha kho te pāpima dūsī māro brāhmaṇagahapatike anvāvisi:
mn50:12.7: etha tumhe, bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme akkosatha paribhāsatha rosetha vihesetha.
mn50:12.8: appevanāma tumhehi akkosiyamānānaṃ paribhāsiyamānānaṃ rosiyamānānaṃ vihesiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ, yathā taṃ dūsī māro labhetha otāranti.
mn50:13.1: atha kho te pāpima brāhmaṇagahapatikā anvāviṭṭhā dūsinā mārena bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti:
mn50:13.2: “ime pana muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kiṇhā bandhupādāpaccā ‘jhāyinosmā jhāyinosmā’ti pattakkhandhā adhomukhā madhurakajātā jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti apajjhāyanti.
mn50:13.3: seyyathāpi nāma ulūko rukkhasākhāya mūsikaṃ magayamāno jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati,
mn50:13.4: evamevime muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kiṇhā bandhupādāpaccā ‘jhāyinosmā jhāyinosmā’ti pattakkhandhā adhomukhā madhurakajātā jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti apajjhāyanti.
mn50:13.5: seyyathāpi nāma kotthu nadītīre macche magayamāno jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati,
mn50:13.6: evamevime muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kiṇhā bandhupādāpaccā ‘jhāyinosmā jhāyinosmā’ti pattakkhandhā adhomukhā madhurakajātā jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti apajjhāyanti.
mn50:13.7: seyyathāpi nāma biḷāro sandhisamalasaṅkaṭīre mūsikaṃ magayamāno jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati,
mn50:13.8: evamevime muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kiṇhā bandhupādāpaccā ‘jhāyinosmā jhāyinosmā’ti pattakkhandhā adhomukhā madhurakajātā jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti apajjhāyanti.
mn50:13.9: seyyathāpi nāma gadrabho vahacchinno sandhisamalasaṅkaṭīre jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati,
mn50:13.10: evamevime muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kiṇhā bandhupādāpaccā ‘jhāyinosmā, jhāyinosmā’ti pattakkhandhā adhomukhā madhurakajātā jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti apajjhāyantī”ti.
mn50:13.11: ye kho pana pāpima tena samayena manussā kālaṃ karonti, yebhuyyena kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
mn50:14.1: atha kho pāpima kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn50:14.2: anvāviṭṭhā kho bhikkhave brāhmaṇagahapatikā dūsinā mārena:
mn50:14.3: ‘etha tumhe, bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme akkosatha paribhāsatha rosetha vihesetha. appevanāma tumhehi akkosiyamānānaṃ paribhāsiyamānānaṃ rosiyamānānaṃ vihesiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ yathā taṃ dūsī māro labhetha otāranti.
mn50:14.4: etha tumhe bhikkhave mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharatha.
mn50:14.5: karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, …pe…
mn50:14.6: muditāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, …pe…
mn50:14.7: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharatha, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharathāti.
mn50:15.1: atha kho te pāpima bhikkhū kakusandhena bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā araññagatāpi rukkhamūlagatāpi suññāgāragatāpi mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihariṃsu. tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā vihariṃsu.
mn50:15.2: karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihariṃsu …pe…
mn50:15.3: muditāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihariṃsu …pe…
mn50:15.4: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihariṃsu. tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā vihariṃsu.
mn50:16.1: atha kho pāpima dūsissa mārassa etadahosi:
mn50:16.2: “evampi kho ahaṃ karonto imesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sīlavantānaṃ kalyāṇadhammānaṃ neva jānāmi āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā. yannūnāhaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatike anvāviseyyaṃ:
mn50:16.3: etha tumhe, bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme sakkarotha garukarotha mānetha pūjetha.
mn50:16.4: appevanāma tumhehi sakkariyamānānaṃ garukariyamānānaṃ māniyamānānaṃ pūjiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ yathā taṃ dūsī māro labhetha otāranti.
mn50:17.1: atha kho te pāpima, dūsīmāro brāhmaṇagahapatike anvāvisi:
mn50:17.2: etha tumhe, bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme sakkarotha garukarotha mānetha pūjetha.
mn50:17.3: appevanāma tumhehi sakkariyamānānaṃ garukariyamānānaṃ māniyamānānaṃ pūjiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ yathā taṃ dūsī māro labhetha otāranti.
mn50:17.4: atha kho te pāpima brāhmaṇagahapatikā anvāviṭṭhā dūsinā mārena bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjenti.
mn50:17.5: ye kho pana pāpima tena samayena manussā kālaṃ karonti, yebhuyyena kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
mn50:18.1: atha kho pāpima, kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn50:18.2: anvāviṭṭhā kho bhikkhave brāhmaṇagahapatikā dūsinā mārena
mn50:18.3: “etha tumhe, bhikkhū sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme sakkarotha garukarotha mānetha pūjetha.
mn50:18.4: appevanāma tumhehi sakkariyamānānaṃ garukariyamānānaṃ māniyamānānaṃ pūjiyamānānaṃ siyā cittassa aññathattaṃ yathā taṃ dūsī māro labhetha otāranti”.
mn50:18.5: etha tumhe bhikkhave, asubhānupassī kāye viharatha. āhāre paṭikūlasaññino sabbaloke anabhiratasaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassinoti.
mn50:19.1: atha kho te pāpima bhikkhū kakusandhena bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā araññagatāpi rukkhamūlagatāpi suññāgāragatāpi asubhānupassī kāye vihariṃsu, āhāre paṭikkūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññino sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassino.
mn50:20.1: atha kho pāpima, kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āyasmatā vidhurena pacchāsamaṇena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn50:21.1: atha kho pāpima dūsī māro aññataraṃ kumāraṃ anvāvisitvā yakkharaṃ gahetvā āyasmato vidhurassa sīse pahāraṃ adāsi. sīsaṃ vobhindi.
mn50:21.2: atha kho pāpima āyasmā vidhuro bhinnena sīsena lohitena galantena kakusandhaṃyeva bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
mn50:21.3: atha kho pāpima kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nāgāpalokitaṃ apalokesi:
mn50:21.5: sahāpalokanāya ca pana pāpima dūsī māro tamhā ca ṭhānā cavi. mahānirayañca upapajji.
mn50:22.1: tassa kho pana pāpima mahānirayassa tayo nāmadheyyā honti:
mn50:22.2: chaphassāyataniko itipi, saṅkusamāhato itipi, paccattavedaniyo itipi.
mn50:22.3: atha kho maṃ pāpima nirayapālā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ:
mn50:22.4: yadā kho te mārisa saṅkunā saṅku hadaye samāgaccheyya,
mn50:23.1: so kho ahaṃ pāpima bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni tasmiṃ mahāniraye apacciṃ.
mn50:23.2: dasavassasahassāni tasseva mahānirayassa ussade apacciṃ vuṭṭhānimaṃ nāma vedanaṃ vediyamāno.
mn50:23.3: tassa mayhaṃ pāpima evarūpo kāyo hoti seyyathāpi manussassa.
mn50:32.4: dūsī ca māro pañcamo ca vaggo.
